_meta.what: Measured street speeds from TomTom's Traffic Flow service.
_meta.source: TomTom Traffic Flow API v4 flowSegmentData, freeFlowSpeed
_meta.fields: points: [lat, lon, direction in degrees 0-180, free-flow km/h, TomTom road class FRC]
_meta.zoom: Requests at zoom 18 (street scale); zoom 12 snaps to the nearest major road and was dropped for unmatched pieces.
_meta.route_phase: Streets without flow data: TomTom routing (Orbis v3, typical traffic at 3 am) from one end of the piece to the other; kept when TomTom's route length is within 15% of the piece (it followed the street).
